entries.zh: 回顾会（迭代结束时开，r 开头）

examples.en: In the last retrospective, we agreed to limit how many tickets are in progress at once.
examples.zh: 上次回顾会上，我们约定要限制同时进行中的任务数量。

situation.zh: 面试官问：团队流程上的问题，你们一般在什么场合提出来？
situation.en: We hold a retrospective at the end of every sprint and pick one or two things to improve.

entries.note: 口头常简称 retro：Let's bring it up at the retro.
collocations: bring it up at the retro

entries.zh: 完成的定义（团队对“做完”的统一标准）

examples.en: Our definition of done includes tests, documentation, and a deploy to staging.
examples.zh: 我们对“完成”的定义包括测试、文档，以及部署到预发环境。

situation.zh: 同事说任务做完了，但其实只是代码写完，还没测也没上线。你想提议：
situation.en: Let's agree on a definition of done, so that a finished ticket means tested and deployed, not just coded.

entries.note: 常缩写成 DoD。
collocations: agree on a definition of done

entries.zh: 按时交付（d 开头的动词）

examples.en: We delivered on time by cutting two features that weren't essential for launch.
examples.zh: 我们砍掉了两个对上线不是必需的功能，从而按时交付了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：讲一次工期很紧的项目，结果怎么样？
situation.en: We managed to deliver on time, mainly because we agreed on the must-haves early and protected them.

entries.note: 反义：miss the deadline；延期说 slip：The release slipped by two weeks.
collocations: deliver on time and within budget

entries.zh: 里程碑

examples.en: The first milestone is a working prototype that the sales team can demo.
examples.zh: 第一个里程碑是一个可以让销售团队演示的可用原型。

situation.zh: 经理问：这个半年的项目，你打算怎么让大家看得到进展？
situation.en: I'd break it into monthly milestones, each with something we can actually demo.

entries.note: 达成里程碑说 hit / reach a milestone。

entries.zh: 结对编程

examples.en: We use pair programming for tricky changes and for introducing new teammates to unfamiliar code.
examples.zh: 遇到棘手的改动，或者要带新同事熟悉陌生的代码时，我们会用结对编程。

situation.zh: 新同事卡在一个并发 bug 上两天了。你想主动提出：
situation.en: Want to do some pair programming on it this afternoon? Two heads might crack it faster.

entries.note: 动词说 pair：Let's pair on this. / I paired with Anna on the fix.

entries.zh: 知识共享

examples.en: We run a short knowledge sharing session every other Friday, and anyone can present.
examples.zh: 我们每隔一周的周五办一次简短的知识分享会，谁都可以讲。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你怎么避免某块系统只有一个人懂？
situation.en: I push for knowledge sharing: rotating who works on what, writing things down, and giving short internal talks.

entries.note: 动词搭配：share knowledge across the team。作定语时常加连字符：a knowledge-sharing session。

entries.zh: 新人入职上手（名词，o 开头）

examples.en: Onboarding used to take a month, so we wrote a guide and automated the local setup.
examples.zh: 以前新人上手要一个月，所以我们写了一份指南，并把本地环境搭建自动化了。

situation.zh: 面试官问：新人加入你们团队，多久能提交第一个改动？
situation.en: We've put a lot of work into onboarding. Most new hires ship a small change in their first week.

entries.note: 动词是 onboard：onboard a new hire。也用于客户和系统接入：onboard a new customer。

entries.zh: 技术方案评审

examples.en: We hold a design review for anything that touches more than one service.
examples.zh: 只要改动涉及不止一个服务，我们就会开技术方案评审。

situation.zh: 同事打算直接开始写一个要改三个服务的大功能。你想建议：
situation.en: Before you start coding, let's do a design review. It's cheaper to catch problems on paper.

entries.note: 和 code review 的区别：design review 在动手写代码之前评审方案。

entries.zh: 跨团队依赖

examples.en: The biggest risk to the schedule is a cross-team dependency on the platform team's new API.
examples.zh: 进度上最大的风险是一个跨团队依赖：我们要等平台团队的新接口。

situation.zh: 经理问：这个项目有什么是你自己控制不了的？
situation.en: There's one cross-team dependency. We need the data team to expose a new endpoint before we can integrate.

entries.note: “依赖某个团队”说 depend on / have a dependency on the platform team。
collocations: have a dependency on another team

entries.zh: 测试金字塔

examples.en: We follow the test pyramid: lots of fast unit tests and only a few slow UI tests.
examples.zh: 我们遵循测试金字塔：大量跑得快的单元测试，只有少量跑得慢的 UI 测试。

situation.zh: 面试官问：单元测试、集成测试、端到端测试，你们各写多少？
situation.en: We follow the test pyramid. Most of our tests are unit tests, with fewer integration tests and just a handful of end-to-end ones.

entries.note: pyramid 读 /ˈpɪrəmɪd/，重音在第一个音节。也叫 testing pyramid。

entries.zh: 测试驱动开发

examples.en: I use test-driven development for tricky logic, where writing the test first clarifies the requirements.
examples.zh: 遇到复杂的逻辑我会用测试驱动开发，先写测试能把需求理清楚。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你是先写代码还是先写测试？
situation.en: It depends. For well-defined logic I like test-driven development: write a failing test, make it pass, then clean up.

entries.note: 缩写 TDD。流程常说成 red, green, refactor：先写一个失败的测试，让它通过，再重构。

entries.zh: 测试套件（一整套测试）

examples.en: The full test suite takes twenty minutes, so I only run the relevant tests locally.
examples.zh: 整套测试跑完要二十分钟，所以我在本地只跑相关的那部分。

situation.zh: 同事问：你这个改动动了公共模块，怎么确认没影响别的地方？
situation.en: I ran the whole test suite, not just the tests for my module, and everything passed.

entries.note: suite 读 /swiːt/，和 sweet 同音，不要读成 suit /suːt/。

entries.zh: 正常流程（一切顺利、不出错的那条路径，h 开头）

examples.en: So far I've only tested the happy path, so error handling still needs work.
examples.zh: 目前我只测了正常流程，错误处理还得再做。

situation.zh: 站会上你想说：功能主流程已经通了，但各种异常情况还没处理。
situation.en: The happy path works end to end. Today I'm handling the failure cases, like timeouts and invalid input.

entries.note: 对应的异常流程可以说 the unhappy path 或 error cases。

entries.zh: 部署频率

examples.en: Our deployment frequency went from once a month to several times a day.
examples.zh: 我们的部署频率从一个月一次提高到了一天好几次。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你怎么衡量团队的交付效率有没有提升？
situation.en: I look at deployment frequency and lead time for changes. If both improve without more incidents, we're getting better.

entries.note: 它是 DORA 四项指标之一，另外三项是 lead time for changes、change failure rate 和恢复服务所需的时间。

entries.zh: 升版本号（动词短语，b 开头）

examples.en: Remember to bump the version in package.json before you publish the library.
examples.zh: 发布这个库之前，记得把 package.json 里的版本号升一下。

situation.zh: 同事在 PR 里给公共库加了一个新方法，但版本号没动。你想提醒：
situation.en: Could you bump the version as well? This adds a feature, so it should be a minor bump.

entries.note: bump 也作名词：a version bump。升级依赖也用它：bump React to 19。

entries.zh: 候选发布版本

examples.en: We deploy each release candidate to staging and let QA test it for two days.
examples.zh: 每个候选发布版本我们都会部署到预发环境，让 QA 测两天。

situation.zh: 产品经理问：下周要发的那个版本，现在能试用了吗？
situation.en: Yes, the first release candidate is on staging. If nothing serious comes up, that's the build we'll ship.

entries.note: 缩写 RC，版本号常写成 2.0.0-rc.1。

entries.zh: 紧急修复（针对线上问题单独发的补丁，一个词）

examples.en: We shipped a hotfix within an hour, then did the proper fix the following week.
examples.zh: 我们一小时内发了一个紧急修复，然后在下一周做了正式的修复。

situation.zh: 线上发现一个会导致重复扣款的 bug，下次正常发版在三天后。你想说：
situation.en: This can't wait for the next release. I'll prepare a hotfix and get it reviewed right away.

entries.note: hotfix 不等正常的发版节奏，通常直接从线上版本拉分支来修。

entries.zh: 开发环境（第一个词用口语缩写）

examples.en: Setting up the dev environment used to take a full day; now it's one command.
examples.zh: 以前搭开发环境要花一整天，现在一条命令就行了。

situation.zh: 同事问：这个实验性的改动，我先部署到哪里试一下比较合适？
situation.en: Try it in the dev environment first. Nobody depends on it, so it's fine if something breaks.

entries.note: dev 是 development 的口语缩写。既可以指自己机器上的 local dev environment，也可以指团队共用的开发环境。

entries.zh: 冒烟测试

examples.en: After each deploy, a smoke test checks that login and checkout still work.
examples.zh: 每次部署之后，会有一个冒烟测试检查登录和结账是否还正常。

situation.zh: 面试官问：发布完成之后，你们怎么快速确认没有把核心功能搞坏？
situation.en: We run a smoke test right after the deploy. It hits the critical endpoints and fails loudly if anything is off.

entries.note: 冒烟测试只验证最核心的功能能不能跑，求快不求全。

entries.zh: 压测（按预期流量施压，l 开头）

examples.en: We ran a load test at three times our peak traffic before the sale.
examples.zh: 大促之前，我们按峰值流量的三倍做了一次压测。

situation.zh: 面试官问：你怎么知道系统能扛住大促的流量？
situation.en: We ran a load test that replayed production traffic at five times the normal rate and watched where it started to degrade.

entries.note: load test 验证预期负载下的表现；stress test 是一直加压到系统撑不住，看极限在哪。也作动词：load-test the service。

entries.zh: 测试替身（替代真实依赖的各种对象的统称）

examples.en: We replace the email service with a test double so the tests don't send real emails.
examples.zh: 我们用测试替身替换了邮件服务，这样测试就不会真的发邮件。

situation.zh: 新同事问：桩、模拟对象、伪实现，这些东西有没有一个统称？
situation.en: Yes, they're all kinds of test double: anything that stands in for a real dependency in a test.

entries.note: double 来自 stunt double（替身演员）。stub、mock、fake、spy 都是 test double 的具体种类。
collocations: replace it with a test double
stand in for a real dependency

entries.zh: 桩（只返回预设结果的测试替身，s 开头）

examples.en: I used a stub that always returns the same exchange rate, so the test is deterministic.
examples.zh: 我用了一个永远返回同一个汇率的桩，这样测试结果就是确定的。

situation.zh: 同事问：测试里要调天气接口，但它的返回每次都不一样，怎么办？
situation.en: Replace it with a stub that returns a fixed response, so the test doesn't depend on the real API.

entries.note: stub 只管返回预设值；mock 还会验证“有没有被调用、怎么调用的”。动词：stub out the API call。

entries.zh: 伪实现（能真正工作的简化版测试替身，f 开头）

examples.en: We test against an in-memory fake of the repository instead of a real database.
examples.zh: 我们用仓储层的一个内存版伪实现来测试，而不是连真实的数据库。

situation.zh: 同事问：每个用例都要手写一堆预设返回值，太啰嗦了，有更省事的办法吗？
situation.en: You could write a fake, like an in-memory version of the store. It behaves like the real thing, so the tests stay simple.

entries.note: fake 有真实可用的逻辑（比如内存版的存储），只是不适合用在生产环境；stub 只返回写死的值。

entries.zh: 技术方案文档（两个词，第二个词用口语缩写）

examples.en: I wrote a design doc comparing three approaches and shared it for comments before coding.
examples.zh: 写代码之前，我写了一份技术方案文档对比三种做法，并发出来征求意见。

situation.zh: 面试官问：做一个比较大的功能之前，你一般先做什么？
situation.en: I start with a short design doc that covers the problem, the options, and the trade-offs, then get feedback from the team.

entries.note: 也叫 tech spec 或 RFC（request for comments）。

entries.zh: （新人）逐步上手、进入状态，r 开头的短语动词

examples.en: It took me about a month to ramp up on the codebase when I joined.
examples.zh: 我刚加入的时候，花了大约一个月才把代码库摸熟。

situation.zh: 面试官问：如果加入我们，你要多久才能独立干活？
situation.en: I usually ramp up quickly. I'd expect to ship small changes in the first two weeks and own a feature within two months.

entries.note: ramp up on + 要熟悉的东西。它也表示“逐步加大”：ramp up traffic、ramp up hiring。名词是 ramp-up：ramp-up time。

entries.zh: 代码归属（哪块代码由谁负责）

examples.en: Clear code ownership means every service has a team that reviews changes and answers questions.
examples.zh: 代码归属清晰，意味着每个服务都有一个团队负责评审改动、回答问题。

situation.zh: 有个公共模块出了 bug，三个团队都说不归自己管。你想指出真正的问题：
situation.en: The real issue is code ownership. Nobody owns that module, so nobody reviews changes to it.

entries.note: GitHub 里用 CODEOWNERS 文件指定各目录的负责人。

entries.zh: 知识孤岛

examples.en: Each team had its own deployment scripts, which created knowledge silos across the department.
examples.zh: 每个团队都有自己的一套部署脚本，结果在整个部门里形成了知识孤岛。

situation.zh: 面试官问：团队按模块分工很细，有什么坏处？
situation.en: You get knowledge silos. Each person only knows their own corner, so reviews get shallow and vacations become risky.

entries.note: silo 读 /ˈsaɪloʊ/。“打破孤岛”说 break down silos。
